items.exampleEn: Dogs don't like the summer heat.
Don't get lost in the forest.
A wild bird flew into our classroom.
items.exampleZh: 一隻野鳥飛進了我們的教室。

items.exampleEn: The earth goes around the sun.

items.exampleZh: 科學家發現了一顆新行星。

items.exampleEn: In the evening, my shadow is very long.
Don't cut the roots when you move the plant.
items.exampleZh: 移動植物時不要剪到根。

items.audioEn: Because of the heat, the zoo opens early and closes at noon.
items.audioZh: 因為天氣太熱，動物園提早開門，中午就關門。
items.questionZh: 動物園為什麼中午就關門？

items.sentenceEn: We must take care of our planet.
items.sentenceZh: 我們必須好好愛護我們的星球。

items.sentenceEn: My cat is afraid of its own shadow.
items.sentenceZh: 我的貓連自己的影子都怕。

items.stemEn: This tree has strong ____ under the ground.
items.stemZh: 這棵樹在地底下有強壯的根。

items.stemEn: Please don't give food to the ____ animals in the park.
items.stemZh: 請不要拿食物給公園裡的野生動物吃。

items.passageEn: Last summer, we went camping in a forest near the mountains. During the day, the heat was strong, so we sat in the shade of tall trees. We saw wild birds and a big tree with roots above the ground. The first night, we lay under the stars, and my brother said, "The earth is just one small planet." The next night, a storm came, and we slept in the car.
items.passageZh: 去年夏天，我們在山邊的一片森林裡露營。白天熱得很，所以我們坐在高大樹木的樹蔭下。我們看到了野鳥，還有一棵根長在地面上的大樹。第一晚，我們躺在星空下，我哥哥說：「地球只是一顆小小的行星。」第二晚來了一場暴風雨，我們就睡在車上。

questions.questionZh: 白天他們為什麼坐在樹蔭下？

options: 來了暴風雨，他們睡在車上

items.promptZh: 這片森林裡住著很多野生動物。
referenceEn: Many wild animals live in this forest.
There are many wild animals in this forest.
rubricZh: 可寫例如 Many … live in…、There are many … in…

items.promptZh: 從太空看，地球是藍色的。
referenceEn: From space, the earth looks blue.
The earth looks blue from space.
rubricZh: 用 the earth 表示「地球」（寫 Earth 也正確）
「看起來是藍色的」可寫，例如 looks blue、is blue 等

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：第②關：釋義「地球；土地」中的「土地」與例句（The earth goes around the sun.＝地球）用法不符；建議只寫「地球」。
執行長第②③關裁示修正：第②關：疑似不道地："we sat in the shadows of tall trees" 表「坐在樹蔭下」應用 in the shade of；shadows 偏「陰影／暗處」。shadow 是本課字，可改用在別句（如地上的樹影）。
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改為 "Last summer, we went camping in a forest near the mountains. During the day, the heat was strong, so we sat in the shade of tall trees. We saw wild birds and a big tree with roots above the ground. The first night, we lay under the stars, and my brother said, \"The earth is just one small planet.\" The next night, a storm came, and we slept in the car."（原 "Last summer, we went camping in a forest near the mountains. During the day, the heat was strong, so we sat in the shadows of tall trees. We saw wild birds and a big tree with roots above the ground. The first night, we lay under the stars, and my brother said, \"The earth is just one small planet.\" The next night, a storm came, and we slept in the car."）；shadow 另有跟讀與 mcq 的情境，本課覆蓋不受影響

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 第②關：正解選項明顯是最長的一個（「來了暴風雨，他們睡在車上」12 字 vs 6–7 字），違反「正解不落在最長集合」；應縮短正解或加長干擾項。
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 執行長裁示：「單題正解最長」類 issue 由全級長度名次分布規則統一處理

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長裁示：後期規則補正：mcq 干擾項——同課兩題 mcq 不共用干擾項、不拿另一題正解當干擾項；混合詞性題至少兩個干擾項放得進空格：planet 與 q13 planets 共用，改本單元形容詞 natural，湊足兩個可代入的干擾項
執行長裁示：後期規則補正：mcq 干擾項——同課兩題 mcq 不共用干擾項、不拿另一題正解當干擾項；混合詞性題至少兩個干擾項放得進空格：planet 與 q13 planets 共用，改本單元形容詞 natural，湊足兩個可代入的干擾項
